operators.name: custom_linear
semantics: Computes linear transformation: output = x @ weight^T + bias, where x has shape [512,1000,128], weight has shape [64,128], bias has shape [64].
Uses standard matrix multiplication semantics: for each batch b and row i, output[b,i,:] = sum_j x[b,i,j] * weight[k,j] + bias[k].
Bias is added to every output element across the last dimension.
Input x may have non-contiguous strides but is logically a [512*1000,128] matrix for the GEMM; the implementation must handle arbitrary strides by appropriate indexing.
Weight and bias are contiguous CUDA tensors.
Output shape is [512,1000,64], dtype float32, device cuda, contiguous strides [64000,64,1].
Uses cuBLAS or a custom CUDA GEMM kernel; no torch operations.

operators.name: custom_gelu
semantics: Applies the GELU activation function elementwise: gelu(x) = x * Phi(x), where Phi is the standard normal CDF.
Uses the exact formula from torch.nn.functional.gelu with default parameters: approximate='none'.
Output has the same shape, dtype, device, and strides as input (the implementation may produce contiguous output but should preserve logical order).
Elementwise operation applies to all 512*1000*64 elements.
No in-place modification of input.

operators.name: custom_softmax
semantics: Computes softmax along dimension dim=1 (the 1000 dimension) of the input tensor of shape [512,1000,64].
For each batch b and feature f, softmax over i=0..999: softmax(x[b,i,f]) = exp(x[b,i,f] - max_i x[b,i,f]) / sum_i exp(x[b,i,f] - max_i x[b,i,f]).
Output values are in range (0,1) and sum to 1 along dim=1 for each batch and feature.
Output has the same shape and dtype as input, device cuda, contiguous strides [64000,64,1].
Implementation must be numerically stable (subtract max before exp).
The 'dim' parameter is allowed to be dynamic but in this task it is always 1; the custom op should handle this value.
Applies nn.Linear(128, 64) to input x of shape [512,1000,128].
Uses weight shape [64,128] and bias shape [64].
Output: linear(x) = x @ weight.T + bias, shape [512,1000,64].
Output dtype float32, device cuda, strides [64000,64,1].
Applies exact GELU activation to the linear output.
Elementwise, no shape change.
Softmax along dimension 1 (the 1000 dimension).
Output shape [512,1000,64], values sum to 1 along dim=1.
Returns a tensor, not a named tuple.
Final output tensor of shape [512,1000,64], dtype float32, device cuda.
